$comment: Every test data file, in repo or outside it. 'location' is 'repo' (under fixtures/) or 'large' (under the folder COPYWCS_TESTDATA_LARGE names, git-ignored). scripts/check-testdata.ps1 verifies presence and SHA-256 of every entry; a 'large' entry that is missing is a warning locally and an error in CI only when 'requiredInCi' is true. Every FITS the tests build themselves comes from FitsTestData; the one fixture is the header of a real Siril plate solve (ADR 0005).
